title: Provenance Event
description: One asset's state within one run. Records the producer (producer_*) and the consumer (actor_*) on the same row; this cannot be backfilled, because asset ownership changes and versions roll forward.

event_id.description: Stable id, referenced by gate-decision.evidence_refs and by receipts. Derived from session_key + asset_id + state + occurred_at.

state.description: fetched: the model actually retrieved the content (service-side record). used: hard evidence matched and a fetch preceded it. used_soft: only soft evidence (a model judgement) matched, which is not enough to promote to used. needs_review: a token matched but no fetch preceded it, so the model may have known it from elsewhere. validated: used, and the corresponding acceptance check passed. corrected: counter-evidence exists.

session_key.description: Normalised session id (client prefix such as 'codebuddy:' removed).

run_id.description: Run id assigned by the E2E runner; may be null for historical fetch-level events.

task_id.description: Evaluation task id; generalisation is counted as distinct values of this field.

occurred_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC, taken from the service-side record's timestamp.

pool_snapshot_at.description: The instant the asset pool was frozen. Assets created after it must be flagged with excluded_by_snapshot.

excluded_by_snapshot.description: true = the asset was created after the pool was frozen and is excluded from all statistics (answer-leak guard).

actor_user_id.description: The user_id of the session that performed this run.

actor_agent_id.description: The agent_id of the session that performed this run.

relation.description: Derived from producer/actor. Reports unknown when either identity is missing; never defaults to self.

observation.description: How the fetch was witnessed. bridge+wire: service-side success plus an asset id parsed from the capture. bridge_only: service-side record only. wire_only: capture only, doubtful. none: no fetch was observed at all (occurs only with needs_review, where a token matched but nothing was ever fetched).

evidence_tier.description: How strong the 'it was used' judgement is. hard: a discriminative token from the asset appears in the run's artifacts. soft: a model judged an asset claim related to the change. Null while state is fetched.

target_type.description: Present from state=used onward: what the asset affected.

proof_refs.description: Resolvable evidence references; sensitive content is not copied. Must be non-empty from state=used onward.

corrected_reason.description: Set only when state=corrected. Only wrong / stale feed the down-weighting path.

ref.description: An id, path or hash that resolves back to the original record.

detail.description: Optional human-readable note, such as the token that matched.
